findings.summary: increment_counter performs a read-modify-write with no locking or atomic replacement, so concurrent callers lose increments and a crash mid-write leaves the counter truncated.
Unvalidated file content is expanded in bash arithmetic context, where an array-subscript payload triggers command substitution and thus code execution.
The contract assertion only checks that the displayName key exists, so it passes on a null or wrong value and cannot detect extra leaked fields.
The equality check grants access when both caller and owner are empty strings, so an unresolved identity against an unowned resource passes authorization.
Despite its name the function adds no failure handling, so a caller using command substitution can consume partial output as a valid item list.
